structured_output.summary: I only partly verified this: I read streams.go and a few greps, and the diff was truncated. One blocking problem: the new TestMain in the integration package calls syscall.Exec, which doesn't exist on Windows, so the whole integration package would fail to compile there. CI runs Windows. Coverage looks otherwise solid, and I found no weakened existing tests.

findings.text: TestMain uses syscall.Exec, which is undefined on Windows, so the integration package fails to compile there (CI runs Windows). Because the tests skip when the exec fails, the h2 extended CONNECT criterion (ACC8) is also only met on Linux and macOS. Use a build-tagged helper, or set the GODEBUG setting in code, instead.
TestStreamNotDetachedClosedOnReload only asserts the close within 5s, so it can't show the stream closes immediately when stream_close_delay is 0.
No test covers a stream_timeout expiry or a backend-initiated close producing the right result label in the metrics or close log (integration or unit).
The only skip I found here is the existing GOOS skip in TestHandlerUpgradedStreamHalfClose. I saw no weakened assertions, but I couldn't see the diff for this file.
streamRegistry.count() appears to be used only by tests.

coverage.note: Echoes through the tunnel after two reloads that keep the upstream.
Removing upstream A closes its tunnel while B still echoes.
Checks the stream is open within the delay and closed after it. The delay=0 case is covered only by TestStreamNotDetachedClosedOnReload, which has a loose 5s bound.
Asserts no handshake entry with skip_handshake set. TestStreamLogsDefault asserts the handshake is logged by default.
Asserts the debug level by default. The detached and level-override cases are in the other log tests.
Echoes through intercept with a catch-all handle_response. Encode is covered by TestStreamThroughEncode and access logging by the log tests.
Asserts nothing reaches the underlying writer after a hijack. The 101-is-final check and the encode check are in separate tests.
The test is skipped when the process can't be re-executed with GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1, and the TestMain doesn't build on Windows. A fix that makes it run on all CI platforms would make it covered.
Not read, and the test name is inferred, not checked. Verify that it asserts each stream is counted once when several close paths fire.
Covers valid and invalid input. Defaults omitted from JSON are covered in TestStreamOptionsJSONOmitsDefaults and the caddyfile_adapt file.
Every listed integration scenario has a test. The h2 one has the platform problem described under ACC8.
Recorder and encode hijack safety are tested. Registry and metrics tests are in streams_test.go and metrics_test.go, which I did not read.
